prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240, initial-scale=1">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#ecede2}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xecede2);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function material(color,roughness=.83){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness});
}
const skin=material(0xffce28), lip=material(0xf8b622);
const dark=material(0x302020), throat=material(0x542127);
const tongue=material(0xf37c76), pink=material(0xd96060);
const clay=group(scene,'Laughing Nailong 奶蛙');

function mesh(parent,name,geo,mat){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);
  m.name=name;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
function oval(parent,name,mat,x,y,z,a,b,c){
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,48,32),mat);
  m.position.set(x,y,z);
  m.scale.set(a,b,c);
  return m;
}
function line(parent,name,points,width,mat){
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(...p)));
  mesh(parent,name,new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve,36,width,10,false),mat);
  for(const [i,p] of [points[0],points[points.length-1]].entries())
    oval(parent,name+' tip '+i,mat,...p,width,width,width);
}
// A pear-shaped body with its weight low over the feet.
const body=group(clay,'Body');
const bodyGeo=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,80,48);
const bp=bodyGeo.attributes.position;
for(let i=0;i<bp.count;i++){
  const x=bp.getX(i), y=bp.getY(i), z=bp.getZ(i);
  const girth=1-.23*y;
  bp.setXYZ(i,x*.99*girth,1.24+1.12*y,z*.83*girth+.09*(1-y*y));
}
bodyGeo.computeVertexNormals();
mesh(body,'Round belly and shoulders',bodyGeo,skin);

for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const leg=group(clay,s<0?'Right leg':'Left leg');
  oval(leg,'Haunch',skin,s*.50,.49,-.025,.46,.45,.53);
  const foot=oval(leg,'Foot',skin,s*.52,.235,.235,.434,.24,.59);
  foot.rotation.y=s*.16;
  const arm=group(body,s<0?'Right arm':'Left arm');
  arm.position.set(s*.80,1.81,.13);
  arm.rotation.z=s*(s<0?-.32:.38);
  arm.rotation.x=-.34;
  oval(arm,'Upper arm',skin,s*.095,-.23,.03,.216,.41,.234);
  const hand=group(arm,'Paw');
  hand.position.set(s*.13,-.49,.106);
  oval(hand,'Rounded mitten',skin,0,0,0,.202,.213,.21);
  oval(hand,'Thumb',skin,-s*.125,.038,.108,.094,.13,.104);
}

// Tapered tail rising gently behind the rump.
const tail=group(clay,'Tail');
const tv=[],ti=[];
for(let j=0;j<=40;j++){
  const t=j/40,r=.442*Math.pow(1-t,.78)+.004;
  for(let k=0;k<=48;k++){
    const a=k*Math.PI/24;
    tv.push(.39*t*t+r*Math.cos(a),.76-.18*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)+.26*t*t+r*Math.sin(a),-.39-1.19*t);
    if(j&&k){
      const q=j*49+k;
      ti.push(q-50,q-49,q,q-50,q,q-1);
    }
  }
}
function surface(parent,name,v,idx,mat){
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(v,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  return mesh(parent,name,geo,mat);
}
surface(tail,'Tail taper',tv,ti,skin);

const head=group(clay,'Head');
head.position.set(0,2.33,.075);
head.rotation.z=-.049;
head.rotation.x=-.065;
// Broad cheek line and a projecting muzzle below a softly domed forehead.
function rx(h){return 1.075*(1-.19*h);}
function rz(h){return .91*(1-.11*h);}
function offset(h){return .035+.144*Math.exp(-Math.pow((h+.21)/.40,2));}
const hg=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,112,80);
const hp=hg.attributes.position;
for(let i=0;i<hp.count;i++){
  const h=hp.getY(i);
  hp.setXYZ(i,hp.getX(i)*rx(h),h*.865,hp.getZ(i)*rz(h)+offset(h));
}
hg.computeVertexNormals();
mesh(head,'Golden head and cheeks',hg,skin);
function face(x,y){
  const h=y/.865;
  return offset(h)+rz(h)*Math.sqrt(Math.max(.00001,1-h*h-(x/rx(h))**2));
}
const mouth=group(head,'Open laughing mouth');
const W=.82;
function upper(u){return -.115+.141*u*u+.013*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*u);}
function lower(u){return upper(u)-.456*Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-u*u),.79);}
function oralDepth(u,t){return .016+.014*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*(1-u*u);}
function ribbon(name,umin,umax,low,high,zfun,mat){
  const v=[],idx=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=16;j++){
    const t=j/16;
    for(let i=0;i<=80;i++){
      const u=umin+(umax-umin)*i/80,x=W*u,y=low(u)*(1-t)+high(u)*t;
      v.push(x,y,face(x,y)+zfun(u,t,y));
      if(i&&j){
        const q=j*81+i;
        idx.push(q-82,q-81,q,q-82,q,q-1);
      }
    }
  }
  surface(mouth,name,v,idx,mat);
}
ribbon('Deep burgundy gape',-1,1,lower,upper,oralDepth,throat);
function tongueTop(u){
  return lower(u)+.158*Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-(u/.72)**2),.79)*(1-.15*Math.cos(7*u));
}
ribbon('Tongue',-.72,.72,lower,tongueTop,()=>.043,tongue);
function mappedLine(parent,name,coords,d,r,mat){
  line(parent,name,coords.map(([x,y])=>[x,y,face(x,y)+d]),r,mat);
}
mappedLine(mouth,'Tongue dimple',[[.015,-.453],[.018,-.472],[.012,-.49]],.046,.009,pink);
const bottom=[], top=[];
for(let i=0;i<=24;i++){
  const u=-1+2*i/24;
  bottom.push([W*u,lower(u)-.006]);
  top.push([W*u,upper(u)+.003]);
}
mappedLine(mouth,'Lower lip',bottom,.023,.028,lip);
mappedLine(mouth,'Upper smile line',top,.025,.019,dark);
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(head,s<0?'Right laughing eye':'Left laughing eye');
  const pts=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=14;i++){
    const t=i/14;
    const x=s*(.265+.269*t);
    const y=.278+.079*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)-.021*t;
    pts.push([x,y,face(x,y)+.019]);
  }
  // Swollen middle and tapered ends give the squeezed eyelids their brush shape.
  const v=[],idx=[];
  for(let j=0;j<pts.length;j++){
    const t=j/(pts.length-1),p=pts[j];
    const rad=.009+.026*Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*t),.65);
    for(let k=0;k<=16;k++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*k/16;
      v.push(p[0],p[1]+rad*Math.cos(a),p[2]+rad*Math.sin(a));
      if(j&&k){
        const q=j*17+k;
        if(s>0)idx.push(q-18,q-17,q,q-18,q,q-1);
        else idx.push(q-18,q,q-17,q-18,q-1,q);
      }
    }
  }
  surface(eye,'Crescent eyelid',v,idx,dark);
  const nostrilX=s*.133,nostrilY=.076;
  oval(head,'Tiny nostril',material(0xaa7421),nostrilX,nostrilY,
    face(nostrilX,nostrilY)+.004,.024,.014,.009);
}

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbeb,0xffe3a8,1.85));
function light(color,intensity,x,y,z){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(l);
}
light(0xfff6df,2.05,-3.5,6,4.5);
light(0xfff8dd,1.4,2.2,3,-4);
light(0xf4f7ff,.48,4,1,3);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.845,1.845,1.845,-1.845,.1,40);
ref.position.set(1.22,2.29,7.5);
ref.lookAt(0,1.61,0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();
const characters=[clay];
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
